sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "currencies" ("code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "fraction_digits" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (fraction_digits BETWEEN 0 AND 8), "is_preset" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_preset" IN (0, 1)), "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('account', 'investment', 'property')), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "opening_value_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (opening_value_minor >= 0), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subgroups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('bank', 'broker')), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("kind", "normalized_name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_details" ("asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES assets (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "bank_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subgroups (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "annual_rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "investment_details" ("asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES assets (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "broker_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subgroups (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "property_details" ("asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES assets (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "address" TEXT NULL, "purchase_price_minor" INTEGER CHECK (purchase_price_minor IS NULL OR purchase_price_minor >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_valuations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES assets (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "effective_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (value_minor >= 0), "currency_code" TEXT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "rate_to_rub" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_rub_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (value_rub_minor >= 0), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_transfers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_transactions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES assets (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal', 'transferOut', 'transferIn')), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0), "currency_code" TEXT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "occurred_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_to_rub" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_rub_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_rub_minor > 0), "comment" TEXT NULL, "transfer_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES asset_transfers (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "revision_no" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision_no >= 1), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, CHECK ((kind IN ('transferOut', 'transferIn') AND transfer_id IS NOT NULL) OR (kind IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal') AND transfer_id IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_transaction_revisions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "transaction_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES asset_transactions (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "revision_no" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision_no >= 1), "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("transaction_id", "revision_no"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('income', 'expense')), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_key" TEXT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NULL, "is_preset" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_preset" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_cashflow_rules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "strategy" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (strategy IN ('fixed', 'deposit_interest')), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('income', 'expense')), "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "amount_minor" INTEGER CHECK (amount_minor IS NULL OR amount_minor > 0), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "account_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES assets (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "property_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES assets (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "affects_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("affects_balance" IN (0, 1)), "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "comment" TEXT NULL, "last_generated_period" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, CHECK (NOT (property_id IS NOT NULL AND account_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (affects_balance = 0 OR account_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (end_date IS NULL OR start_date <= end_date), CHECK ((strategy = 'fixed' AND amount_minor IS NOT NULL) OR (strategy = 'deposit_interest' AND amount_minor IS NULL)), CHECK (strategy = 'fixed' OR (kind = 'income' AND account_id IS NOT NULL AND affects_balance = 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cashflow_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('income', 'expense')), "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "occurred_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_to_rub" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_rub_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_rub_minor > 0), "affects_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("affects_balance" IN (0, 1)), "comment" TEXT NULL, "property_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES assets (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "account_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES assets (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "asset_transaction_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES asset_transactions (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "recurring_rule_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES recurring_cashflow_rules (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "revision_no" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision_no >= 1), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, CHECK (NOT (property_id IS NOT NULL AND account_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (affects_balance = 0 OR account_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK (affects_balance = 1 OR asset_transaction_id IS NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cashflow_entry_revisions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entry_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES cashflow_entries (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "revision_no" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision_no >= 1), "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("entry_id", "revision_no"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exchange_rates" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_to_rub" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('cbr', 'manual')), "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("currency_code", "date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('accounts', 'investments')), "target_amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_amount_minor > 0), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'achieved', 'closed')), "target_date" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_assets" ("goal_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES goals (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES assets (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY ("goal_id", "asset_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "investment_locked_amounts" ("asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES assets (id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id", "currency_code"));
